what: With the photo inside the frame scaled up to 1.18x, it drifts slowly upward from 0% to −9% of its own height between the frame entering at the bottom of the screen and leaving at the top (scrub 1 — follows the scroll 1 second late). It moves only within the enlarged margin so the frame edges never go empty. Attached to the element itself with no media child, it keeps its size and only its position drifts — use it to make decoration such as a dark circle behind a photo float up

options.[data-fx-part=media]: Photo (child) that flows inside the cell — if none, the element itself flows
options.scale: Scale to grow in advance, default 1.18 (1 if there is no media)
options.to: yPercent on exit, default −9 — the original concept used −20
options.scrub: Trailing delay (sec), default 1 — if true, immediate
options.widen: Horizontal scale to widen along with it (scaleX end value), no default — Brand original stage 1.15
options.origin: Transform axis (transform-origin), default center — Brand circle stage ”50% 0%” (top edge)
options.end: ScrollTrigger end, default bottom top — Brand circle stage ”bottom bottom”
options.trigger: Ancestor to use as scroll reference (selector, closest) — the element itself if none

use: · Decoration:
note: GSAP uses transform, so attach any other image motion to the outer wrapper
